call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at 75% over FY26, with consolidated EBITDA margin of 20-22%.
Business is H2-heavy: 70-75% of annual revenue is expected in H2, as in prior years.
Received a 200 MW LOA from NLC India in July, a repeat order.
Receivables are expected to fall significantly over the next 3-4 quarters as equipment supply replaces turnkey EPC.
Management sees only force majeure, such as the Middle East crisis, as a risk to meeting guidance.
Analysts pressed on repeated guidance misses; management said the equipment pivot will show results mainly from Q3.
INOX Green received NCLT Ahmedabad approval for the Wind World India acquisition; formalities expected in Q2FY27.
Demerger of INOX Green's power evacuation business into INOX Renewable Solutions completed with record date August 1, 2026.
The 4.4-MW turbine is on track for commercial launch within this calendar year after approvals, expected to aid margin improvement.
Receivables face delays in PSU contracts; management expects the equipment-supply pivot and group orders to improve the working capital cycle.
Management declined to give FY26 megawatt execution or an FY27 order inflow target, saying it now guides only on revenue.

operating_notes.text: Order book of 3.1 GW includes about 500 MW from group company Inox Clean, with equipment supply now 75-80% of the book versus 100% turnkey 24 months ago.
Inox Clean Energy plans to add 3 GW+ of capacity annually, 20-30% of it wind, expected to fill about one-third of Inox Wind's annual execution.
Inox Green's portfolio is 13+ GWp (about 10.5 GW wind, rest solar) with FY27 EBITDA guidance above ₹600 Cr and two acquisitions adding roughly 6.5 GW of O&M assets.
Order book of ~4.4 GW as of July 2026, with equipment supply at ~59% of third-party orders and turnkey at 41%.
INOX Clean Energy plans to set up 3 GW+ of IPP capacity annually; 1.5 GW MOU signed in June 2026, of which 500 MW is firm orders.
INOX Green's O&M portfolio was 13.3 GW as of June 2026, including ~10.5 GW of wind assets and the balance solar.

timeline.summary: On 29 May 2026 Inox Wind's Q4 FY26 call guided FY27 revenue growth of ~75% over FY26's ₹4,500 Cr, after FY26 fell ₹400-500 Cr short of its ₹5,000 Cr target.
On 7 August 2026, Inox Wind's Q1FY27 earnings call maintained FY27 guidance of 75% revenue growth and 20-22% EBITDA margin, with Q1 revenue at ₹872 Cr and an order book of ~4.4 GW.
